s: Baal qeri muttar biqriat shema ubo b' seipim: kol hattemeim, apillu tuma yotze alehem miggupan kegon zab vezaba vekayyotze bahen — qorin qeriat shema umitpalelin. Chutz mibbaal qeri, shehotzio ezra min kelal hattemein vaasaro ben bedibre tora ben biqriat shema utepilla, kede shello yihyu talmide chakamim metzuyin etzel neshotehen ketarnegolim. Velo poshta taqqana zo berob yisrael, veachar kak botla otah taqqana legamre, mishshum bittul tora umishshum bittul pirya veribya, veheemidu haddabar al haddin sheap baal qeri muttar bedibre tora ubiqriat shema ubbitpilla belo tebila ubelo rechitza bet' qabbin. Veken pashat hamminhag. Veap bizman shennahagu bitbila — lo hitzrikuhu ella lebari sheshshimmesh mittato, abal choleh sheraa qeri leonso — patur mikkelum. (Vecholeh sheshshimmesh mittato) ubari leonso — dayyo bet' qabbin sheyyishpok alayv mikkeli achat o apillu mib' veg', abal mid' kelim en mitztorpin. Vehu sheyyatchil hashsheni ad shello pasaq harishon, veken hashshelishi ad shello pasaq hashsheni. Vetisha qabbin ellu enan metaharin ella kesheshshopekin alayv abal lo keshettobel bahem, ben shehem bakkeli ben baqqarqa, ad sheyyihyeh arbaim sea (baqqarqa), veaz moilim litbol bahem apillu lebari sheshshimmesh mittato, apillu hem sheubim:

Nahagu hannashim tohora uperishut beatzman shello likkanes lebet hakkeneset veshello lirot seper tora bishat niddutan, vegam keshemitpalelin enan omedot bipne chabrotehem. Umishshum minhag vekabod osin ken velo mishshum issur, ubime libbunan lo nahagu lehachamir. Ubeyamim noraim miyyom echad shel selichot veelak sherabbim mitassepim lelek lebet hakkeneset — muttarot lelek lebet hakkeneset ap bime niddutan kishar nashim, ki yihyeh lahen leitztzabon gadol shehakkol mitassepin vehen yaamdu chutz. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh, kegon shemmassia et benah o bittah, o shehi beatzmah yoledet sheholekin lebet hakkeneset achar d' shabuot — mutteret apillu hi nidda. Vekol zeh lelek lebet hakkeneset, abal lehitpallel bebetah ulebarek kol habberakot ubiprat birkat hammazon veqiddush shehen min hattora — chayyabot lekulle alma apillu bishat niddatan. Umah shennohagin shello lehazkir et hashshem bishat niddatan o shello ligga basseper — en minhag zeh iqqar, veal kol panim tishma birkat hammazon veqiddush meacherim, veim en acher teqaddesh utebarek beatzmah belachash kol habberakot shechayyebet bahen: (seliq hilkot qeriat shema ubirkoteha beezrat hashshem yitbarek):
